venue.name: Ruang Santay Coffee & Space
venue.address: Jl. Tukad Balian No.164, Renon, Denpasar Selatan, Kota Denpasar, Bali 80226

items.information:
Bali Mini Speedcubing 2026 is a one-day mini speedcubing competition featuring a limited selection of official events.

All registered competitors will receive a complimentary snack/meal/drink (TBA). 

Please note that registrations will not be processed unless the confirmation form has been completed. You can access the confirmation form [here](https://forms.gle/pbGQ1wcsHmQh6a7g9)

For further information, please contact the committee using the contact details provided.

____

Bali Mini Speedcubing 2026 adalah kompetisi speedcubing kecil yang diselenggarakan selama satu hari dengan jumlah event yang terbatas.

Setiap peserta yang terdaftar akan mendapatkan snack/makanan/minuman gratis (TBA).

Pendaftaran tidak akan diproses apabila peserta belum mengisi formulir konfirmasi yang dapat diakses di [sini](https://forms.gle/pbGQ1wcsHmQh6a7g9)

items.information:
All the participants are expected to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except the New comers) will be assigned to a particular event that they have to Judge (or) Scramble in which they are participating. 
All the staff/volunteering assignments will be decided by the organising team and participants will be informed of the same 2 days prior to the event, we will ensure that your volunteering does not affect your events.

**ALL PARTICIPANTS HAVE TO BE AT THE VENUE ATLEAST 40 MINUTES BEFORE THE START OF THEIR EVENT. LATE COMERS WILL NOT BE ALLOWED TO PARTICIPATE.**

Please check out all the tabs for additional important information.

items.name: NCSU Wolfpack Spring 2026

venue.name: North Carolina State University Talley Student Union
venue.details: Piedmont + Mountains Ballroom on the third level (one floor up from main level entrances)

items.information:
**All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NCSUWolfpackSpring2026#69863-competitor-information) prior to registering.**
Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email.

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NCSUWolfpackSpring2026#69868-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5MDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55d04463db7d97e68854ce1ad4ffb960c1ed23fd/SOUTHEAST_5.png)

Additionally, this competition has been made possible with the help of CubePack, the cubing club at NC State! All NC State students who are official members of CubePack on Get Involved will receive refunded registration. You must pay up front and will be refunded after the competition.
